summary.text: 東, “east,” began as a picture of a bag tied at both ends. The drawing was borrowed for its sound to write the direction. Its later resemblance to a sun inside a tree has produced an appealing sunrise story, but that does not explain the early shape.

formation.text: An object pictograph was borrowed for the word “east.”

components.text: The whole outline represents a tied bag in this account. Apparent 日 and 木 shapes are not separate original sun and tree components.

history.text: The direction use is already present in oracle-bone and bronze writing. Thus the character’s later everyday meaning belongs to its borrowed use, while the shape preserves the older object picture.

uncertainties.text: Descriptions of the object vary between a bag, basket, and tied bundle. The tied-container account explains the early outline more securely than the sun-and-tree interpretation, without fixing every detail of the object.

evidence.text: The sun 日 rising behind a tree 木; compare 西
Pictograph of a basket or a bag. The current meaning "east" is a phonetic loan.
動也。从木。官溥說：从日在木中。凡東之屬皆从東。

Jiajie (假借) and ideogram (指事): 束 (OC *hljoɡ) or 橐 (OC *tʰaːɡ) borrowed for sound 東 (OC *toːŋ), with a horizontal stroke added as a distinguishing mark to differentiate the character from 束.
Alternatively, it is also thought to be a pictogram (象形) of either a bundle of faggots tied together or a bag tied at both ends (like a cellophane-wrapped candy with the ends twisted).
Interpreted in the Shuowen Jiezi as an ideogrammic compound (會意 /会意) the sun (日) rising behind a tree (木). According to Allan (1991) p. 47-50, the character represents the Fu Sang tree. However, the original form is rather different, hence any interpretation tied to a tree is most likely a folk etymology.
See the top component of 曹 in the original version. See also 柬, 熏, 西 and 鹵/卤.
Cognate with Chepang थोङ्सा (thoŋ‑, “lighten; be bright”) and Chepang थोङ्ह (thoŋh, “awake time (as opposed to dream time)”) (Schuessler, 2007). Perhaps related to or influenced by 暾 (OC *tʰuːn, “rising sun”).
動也。从木。官溥說：从日在木中。凡東之屬皆从東。
